title: Generalised Balanced Softmax: A Finite-Data Perspective on Logit Adjustment for Long-Tailed Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2607.22258v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Models trained on long-tailed data using standard softmax tend to exhibit higher training error and a larger generalisation gap for classes with fewer training samples. We characterise this class-wise disparity as the preference issue and quantify it using a new metric, the model imbalance level $I$. To understand this issue, we analyse how imbalanced training data adversely affects class-wise gradients under standard softmax training. This paper then develops a finite-data Generalised Balanced Softmax (GBS) framework for analysing and mitigating the preference issue. The framework uses the training-time logit adjustment $z_{nc}+\beta\log|N_c|$, which is algebraically identical to the training-time logit-adjusted loss of Menon et al. (2021) when $\tau=\beta$. translated_title: 广义平衡Softmax：面向长尾识别的Logit调整的有限数据视角
translated_abstract: 使用标准softmax在长尾数据上训练的模型，对于训练样本较少的类别往往表现出更高的训练误差和更大的泛化差距。我们将这种类别间的差异表征为“偏好问题”，并使用一个新的度量指标——模型不平衡水平 $I$ 来量化它。为了理解这一问题，我们分析了不平衡的训练数据在标准softmax训练下如何对各类别梯度产生不利影响。本文随后提出了一个有限数据视角下的广义平衡Softmax（GBS）框架，用于分析和缓解偏好问题。该框架采用训练时的logit调整 $z_{nc}+\beta\log|N_c|$，当 $\tau=\beta$ 时，它在代数上与Menon等人（2021）提出的训练时logit调整损失完全一致。当 $\beta=1$ 时，该框架也与Balanced Softmax以及在真实数据分布下由Fisher一致性论证所支持的单位调整相吻合，对应……
tldr: 本文提出有限数据视角下的广义平衡Softmax（GBS）框架，通过新提出的“模型不平衡水平”度量刻画长尾数据下标准softmax训练中的类别偏好问题，并利用训练时logit调整在统一框架下分析与缓解该问题。
